roles.name: Product lead / product owner
roles.responsibilities: Own product outcomes, personas, B2C/B2B/B2B2C scope, roadmap, priorities, commercial assumptions, success metrics and acceptance decisions. Resolve scope conflicts without deleting requirements.
roles.outputs: Vision, PRD, roadmap, product acceptance and scope-change proposals.

roles.name: Insurance domain and underwriting specialist
roles.responsibilities: Define product structures, coverages, exclusions, eligibility, rating inputs, quote validity, underwriting, inspections, issuance, endorsements, renewals and claims. Distinguish advisory services from insurer-authorized actions.
roles.outputs: Product templates, insurance glossary, policy and claim state machines, insurer-rule validation.

roles.name: Business / systems analyst
roles.responsibilities: Decompose every capability into atomic requirements, business rules, personas, workflows, field dictionaries, states, failure cases and traceability. Separate buyer, payer, policyholder, insured, beneficiary, distributor and carrier.
roles.outputs: SRS, requirements registry, business rules, acceptance criteria and traceability matrix.

roles.name: UX/UI, accessibility and localization designer
roles.responsibilities: Design all storefronts and dashboards, information architecture, responsive interaction, RTL/LTR layouts, accessible forms and tables, error recovery and design tokens. Minimize perceived latency without concealing real status.
roles.outputs: Screen inventory, navigation maps, design system, UI states, accessibility and localization specifications.

roles.name: Staff software / solution architect
roles.responsibilities: Own bounded contexts, deployment boundaries, tenancy, data ownership, API/event contracts, architecture decisions and dependency rules. Prefer the simplest architecture meeting measured requirements.
roles.outputs: C4 and sequence diagrams, ADRs, module contracts and architecture conformance.

roles.name: Performance and capacity engineer
roles.responsibilities: Own workload assumptions, performance budgets, profiling, query and frontend analysis, concurrency limits, load/soak tests, capacity models and cost-per-transaction. Review all critical journeys.
roles.outputs: NFR budgets, test workloads, benchmark evidence, regression gates and bottleneck backlog.

roles.name: Next.js frontend engineer
roles.responsibilities: Implement accessible localized storefronts and dashboards, rendering boundaries, authenticated data access, explicit caching, typed API clients, progressive quote results, form behavior and frontend tests.
roles.outputs: Next.js applications, shared UI packages, route tests, bundle and Web Vitals instrumentation.

roles.name: NestJS backend / domain engineer
roles.responsibilities: Implement application use cases, modules, validation, authorization, business invariants, transactions, APIs, outbox events, workers, feature controls and post-sale servicing.
roles.outputs: NestJS services and workers, domain tests, transactional behavior and published API contracts.

roles.name: Partner integration and workflow engineer
roles.responsibilities: Build carrier-specific adapters, canonical mapping, authentication, schemas, asynchronous workflows, idempotency, polling/callbacks, failure classification and reconciliation.
roles.outputs: Adapter SDK, contract simulators, integration studio, conformance tests and partner onboarding runbooks.

roles.name: Database / data platform engineer
roles.responsibilities: Own relational models, indexes, query plans, tenant boundaries, migrations, transactional consistency, connection budgets, backups, retention and export/import design.
roles.outputs: ERDs, data dictionary, migrations, indexing plans, restore tests and data lifecycle rules.

roles.name: Application security and privacy engineer
roles.responsibilities: Model threats; implement object/property authorization, privileged access, secret handling, encryption, auditability, secure integrations and privacy minimization. Review cache isolation and multi-tenant exposure.
roles.outputs: Threat model, security controls, privacy matrix, negative tests and security release evidence.

roles.name: Payments, accounting and settlement specialist
roles.responsibilities: Define payment verification, allocations, installment schedules, precise monetary units, refunds, wallets, ledger invariants, commissions, insurer settlement and reconciliation.
roles.outputs: Financial model, payment/ledger specifications, accounting tests and settlement runbooks.

roles.name: Quality engineering / test automation engineer
roles.responsibilities: Own risk-based testing, executable acceptance criteria, unit/integration/contract/E2E suites, accessibility checks, mode/tenant matrices, test data, fault injection and evidence quality.
roles.outputs: Test strategy, fixtures, automated suites, regression results and quality gates.

roles.name: Platform / DevOps / SRE engineer
roles.responsibilities: Own reproducible environments, CI/CD, infrastructure, deployment, autoscaling, telemetry, alerts, queue durability, operational SLOs, recovery and rollback.
roles.outputs: Local environment, pipeline definitions, deployment architecture, dashboards, runbooks and recovery evidence.

roles.name: Analytics / BI engineer
roles.responsibilities: Define consent-aware event taxonomy, conversion metrics, product reporting, seller/carrier/corporate analytics, freshness and access-controlled exports without burdening transactional workloads.
roles.outputs: Tracking plan, metric dictionary, analytical models and report specifications.

roles.name: Content, SEO and growth specialist
roles.responsibilities: Define original product content, insurer profiles, CMS approvals, public indexing, metadata, campaigns, loyalty/referral attribution and compliant communications.
roles.outputs: CMS/SEO requirements, content taxonomy, lifecycle messaging and campaign rules.

roles.name: Technical writer / documentation engineer
roles.responsibilities: Maintain the docs information architecture, templates, source registry, glossary, cross-links, machine-readable manifests, examples, guides and documentation validation.
roles.outputs: Complete docs tree, docs-as-code checks, coverage reports and operator/developer guides.

roles.name: Engineering delivery / release lead
roles.responsibilities: Sequence dependency-aware vertical slices, coordinate role reviews, track blockers, manage changes and readiness gates, and ensure claimed completion is supported by evidence.
roles.outputs: Implementation plan, work ledger, release checklist, checkpoint and readiness reports.

roles.name: Insurance regulatory / legal compliance reviewer
roles.responsibilities: Identify jurisdiction-specific licensing, distribution, privacy, financing, marketing, records and contractual obligations for qualified human validation. Never invent legal approval or insurer authority.
roles.outputs: Compliance questions, evidence register, launch restrictions and sign-off requirements.

roles.name: Insurance operations, claims and partner-support specialist
roles.responsibilities: Define manual underwriting and issuance queues, customer/partner service, claims coordination, escalation, exception ownership, provider onboarding, fulfillment and staff tools.
roles.outputs: Operating procedures, queue SLAs, operational dashboards, support taxonomy and UAT scenarios.

roles.name: Mobile / PWA client engineer
roles.responsibilities: Define installable web experiences, mobile forms and uploads, permissions, deep links, notifications and offline limitations; evaluate separately whether native applications are required.
roles.outputs: PWA/mobile specification and tests; explicit native-app scope and additional-stack decision when needed.
